The 256-entry sprite pool reset, allocated, and drawn by Effect_ResetSpritePool, Effect_AllocateSprite and Effect_DrawSprites.

Battle_UpdateTurnCamera switches on this value and advances it after its timed phase.
Battle_UpdateTurnCamera initializes it to 60 and decrements it to end the current camera phase.
Battle_UpdateTurnCamera indexes D_8007B908 with this selected enemy slot.
Battle_StartBossEncounter and Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter set it; bit 1 is tested as battle-active across player, enemy and HUD code.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition decrements the delay set when combat starts or a turn ends.
Battle_EndTurn advances this index through D_8007C050 to select the next living enemy.
Battle setup sets it from D_8007B900; turn selection and HUD loops use it as a bound.
Battle setup stores encounter or boss X; rings, camera and movement use it as the combat center.
Battle setup stores encounter or boss Z; rings, camera and movement use it as the combat center.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition copies the selected enemy X here; movement and a ring effect use it.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition copies the selected enemy Z here; movement and a ring effect use it.
Battle setup assigns 100 or a boss-indexed radius; movement clamps against it and ring creation uses it.
Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup appends actor pointers and battle setup seeds entry zero.
Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup increments this count when appending to battle_spawned_actor_ptrs.
Battle setup stores the slot returned by Effect_CreateTerrainRing and fades it at battle end.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition stores the ring slot around the active actor and fades it when the turn ends.

Battle_ResetState points it at the selected map group table; Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup reads entries from it.

Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter adds player travel to this float and tests it against 50.
Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter raises this threshold and compares it with Math_Rand(2000).
Battle_UpdateTurnCamera indexes this table to adjust camera position and distance.
Battle_StartBossEncounter indexes this eight-entry radius table by boss ID.
Anim_DrawNode stores up to four transformed node positions here; player code reads the first.
Anim_DrawModel clears it and Anim_DrawNode increments it when saving node positions.
Anim_DrawNode builds an aim-at-camera matrix here and converts it to an N64 matrix.

Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this right X bound.

Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this bottom Y bound.

Hud_DrawChestMarker and Hud_DrawTextSpotMarker use the two angle elements for bobbing.
Hud_DrawMeleeTargetMarker advances this angle and uses its sine for marker bobbing.
Hud_Draw updates this frame up to 12 and draws meters or levels with its squared value.

Hud_DrawPlayerMeters eases this value toward current MP divided by maximum MP times 56 and draws the second bar.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation and its draw path use this eight-frame timer for the selected element animation.

Player code sets 30 and Hud_Draw decrements the timer while showing a timed combat hint.
Player code and Hud_UpdateElementAllocation set eight frames; draw code uses it for alpha and input timing.
Battle/enemy code sets 60; Hud_Draw decrements it and positions a timed panel.
Core_RunGameplayLoop loads this audio sequence when channel zero is idle, then resets it to -1.
HUD draw routines set this X origin for panels, meters and clipped texture rectangles.
HUD draw routines set this Y origin for panels, meters and clipped texture rectangles.

Hud_DrawElementLevels advances this sine angle for the pulsing element icons.
Hud_DrawNumber uses this array as glyph-string input for formatted digits.
Hud_DrawElementLevels and Hud_UpdateElementAllocation index this four-color table by element.
Hud_UpdateAndDrawActorStatusIndicators tests these eight bit masks against active actor statuses.
Hud_UpdateAndDrawActorStatusIndicators uses these four masks for the secondary status icon positions.
Hud_DrawElementLevels tests these four masks against player unlock bits.
Hud_DrawSpellInput selects one of these four X/Y icon positions by recent input direction.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation selects one of these four X/Y positions by element index.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation sets these bits when a selected element reaches level 50.
Hud_DrawNumber indexes this table to choose spacing for formatted numeric glyphs.
